_comment: Explicit allowlist for background maintenance. Being public is not consent;
a repository is maintained only if it appears here with enabled=true.
Order of work is least-recently-maintained first, priority as tiebreak.
Only Augusto flips enabled. Automation never adds a repository to this file.

repos.why: Public AGPL product with a large test suite - the repo where maintenance work pays off most.
Published protocol + PyPI package; regressions there reach installs.
Live Cloudflare Worker, MIT. Maintenance only - deploy stays with Claude.
Public portfolio demo. Recruiters read it, so drift is expensive.
Small public MIT tool - low blast radius, good first target.
Published MCP server; keeping it current is real maintenance.
